Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The Sri Lankan players make their way out to the middle, followed by the Aussie opening duo of Ben McDermott and Ashton Agar. Spin to start off things as Maheesh Theekshana has been handed the new ball. Can he give them the perfect start like last time?
... The Run Chase ...

Right then, Australia need 140 to take 4-0 lead in this series and Sri Lanka need a spirited bowling performance here to defend this total. Can their bowlers help them register their first victory of the series? Stay tuned for an interesting second-half of this game.

Aussies took some time to get into their stride today but the introduction of Ashton Agar provided the breakthrough straightaway. Finch rotated his bowlers quite well and despite wickets not coming in the first half of the innings, Aussies kept the pressure on. A brilliant piece of fielding by Maxwell that gave them their second wicket lifted their spirit and then wickets kept coming at regular intervals for them. Ashton Agar was the pick of the bowlers as he gave nothing away and pacers at other end took full advantage of it as Australia have put together another convincing bowling performance.

Sri Lanka have failed to get good starts in this series and they needed their openers to set the tone here. They did that to a certain degree but Danushka Gunathilaka perished after promising much more. However, Nissanka and Mendis kept the scoreboard ticking with singles and doubles at regular intervals but the same thing led to their downfall as Mendis was run out while stealing ths second run. Things went downhill from there as after a brief partnership between Nissanka and Asalanka, wickets started to fall quite quickly and in the end, Sri Lanka have ended with yet another disappointing batting performance.

This has been a brilliant fightback by Australia! Sri Lanka were well on their way to get a score around 160 here at the halfway mark but some poor batting and some superb bowling in the second half have ensured that Sri Lanka have been restricted to a below-par score here. However, a good final over took them near 140 but Aussies will still go into the break as a happier unit.

Slower delivery, fuller and wider. Chamika Karunaratne looks to go inside-out over extra cover but can only manage to mistime it towards the fielder inside the ring. A single to finish and Sri Lanka end with 139/8!
SIX! Clean strike! In the slot again from Kane Richardson and Chamika Karunaratne takes full advantage of it. He clears the front leg and smokes it way over the long on fence. Geez, that's a big hit!
On off, this is driven through covers for a single.
FOUR! Crunched! On middle, Jeffrey Vandersay makes room and then holds his shape to smash the ball through covers for a boundary.
Full and straight, Chamika Karunaratne looks to go big downtown but gets a thick outside edge towards cover. Just a single then.
FOUR! Something to smile about for Sri Lanka. This is in the slot and Chamika Karunaratne heaves it into the cow corner fence for a welcome boundary.
Good short ball, around off. This one skims through and Vandersay is well beaten.
Jeffrey Vandersay is the next man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! This is catastrophic for Sri Lanka! Right in the slot, on off and Chamika Karunaratne has thumped it on the bounce to Aaron Finch at mid off. There is a huge mix up in the middle as Karunaratne wants the single but Maheesh Theekshana is hesitant. Finch waits and waits and then throws it towards the keeper's end. Theekshana runs for his life and puts in the desperate dive but Matthew Wade with an exceptional keeping, runs in and throws the ball onto the stumps while diving. The decision is taken upstairs and the replays show that even with the dive, Theekshana is nowhwre in the frame.
Ooh, another spicy bouncer! This is banged in short, around middle. Maheesh Theekshana hops and gets an inside edge as he looks to pull. The ball rolls towards backward square leg and they get a run.
A length ball, on off. Theekshana squeezes the cover drive through the infield and picks up a couple of runs.
Full and straight, this is driven straight to mid off.
Maheesh Theekshana is the next man in.

OUT! Cleaned up! Another one bites the dust and Jhye Richardson picks up his second wicket of the night. Dushmantha Chameera gives the charge and Richardson is smart enough to change the pace of the ball and bowl it a lot slower. Richardson also manages to find the blockhole with perfection. Chameera misses the heave leg side and ends up playing all around it. The ball crashes into the base of middle stump and Australia on top of proceedings here.
Jhye Richardson is back to complete his spell.
A well-directed short ball, around the helmet. Dushmantha Chameera somehow manages to fend it away towards point for a single.
Around the top of middle. Chameera blocks it out.
On middle, this is worked on the leg side for a run.
Dushmantha Chameera is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Unlucky! It is a really nice pick-up shot from Dasun Shanaka but he has found the fielder with perfection. Kane Richardson angles this one on the pads and Shanaka with a whip across towards the square leg fence. The ball is hit with real venom but Ashton Agar is a tall man and he runs to his right and reaches out to take a good catch. Sri Lanka certainly losing their way now and Richardson has two wickets in the over.
Commentary.Howout: c Ashton Agar b Kane Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: Full, around off. This is pushed to mid off for a single.
Chamika Karunaratne is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sri Lanka tumbling like a house of cards now! A juicy half-volley outside off from Kane Richardson. Dinesh Chandimal looks to hit it a bit too hard and doesn't get any sort of elevation on it. Chandimal ends up thumping it straight to the eksipper, Aaron Finch at extra cover and he takes a really sharp catch. Richardson has his man and Sri Lanka in a spot of bother.
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Kane Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up on off. Chandimal heaves it across the line but miscues it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A tossed up delivery on middle. Shanaka skips down the track and heaves it towards the leg side for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off. Shanaka skips down the track and plays it back to the bowler.
Quicker on off. Shanaka pushes it to covers for a single.
WIDE! A googly this time but down the leg side. Shanaka looks to sweep but misses.

OUT! STUMPED! It was a lot closer than it looked on first glance. Nicely tossed up, well outside off. Pathum Nissanka skips down the track and tries to go inside-out. He gets undone in flight and turns and misses it completely. Matthew Wade does really well to reach the ball and whips off the bails in a flash. the replay shows that Nissanka almost got his bat down in time but it wasn't enough. Adam Zampa gets the breakthrough and both set batters are now back in the hut. The skipper, Dasun Shanaka walks out to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: st Matthew Wade b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: Is this Stumped? The replays roll in and they first check if there is any bat involved. Hotsopt shows not bat there and the replays further roll to find Nissanka out of his crease. So Pathum Nissanka has to walk back.
Pushed wider, this is driven through covers for a single.
A spicy short ball, on off. Nissanka gets beaten by the pace and bounce but no wide is called. Pathum Nissanka seems disappointed with that decision.
Shorter this time, angling on the hips. Nissanka looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the thigh pads and the ball loops up past the keeper and they get a couple.
Dinesh Chandimal is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Charith Asalanka tries to up the ante but perishes! A good length ball, around off. Asalankadances down the track and looks to dispatch it over the long on fence. He ends up launching it really high and towards the mid off region. Josh Inglis over there settles underneath it and takes a very good catch. Jhye Richardson is delighted with that.
Commentary.Howout: c Josh Inglis b Jhye Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: Banged in short, at the body. Nissanka tries to pull it away but the ball hurries onto him and he gets a top edge around the backward square leg region. Single taken.
FOUR! Nicely driven! Length again, outside off. Pathum Nissanka gives the charge and creams it through extra cover for a boundary.
A length ball, around leg and at 141 clicks. Asalanka tucks it towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
Ashton Agar is done with his spell. Jhye Richardson (2-0-9-0) comes back in to replace him.

An appeal from Zampa but going down leg! A flatter delivery on middle and quicker this time. Pathum Nissanka goes back and looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is an appeal. However, it looks like going down leg and the umpire is not interested.
Flatter and shorter around leg. Charith Asalanka clips it towards square leg for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle.Nissanka tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another late-sut to this flatter delivery on off. This time just a single towards the short third man fielder.
FOUR! One brings two now! A flatter delivery around off. Charith Asalanka waits for it and late-cuts it fine as he beats the short third man fielder for a boundary/

FOUR! Ohh...so a misfield finally gives away a boundary! A fuller delivery on middle. Charith Asalanka sweeps it towards the backward square leg region and Ben McDermott recahes the ball but ends up making a mess of it and it goes away for a boundary.
Shorter around leg and Charith Asalanka sweeps it to short fine leg for a single.
They are dealing in singles at the moment! A fuller delivery on middle. Nissanka skips down the track and pushes it to long off for a single.
Dot ball now! Quicker on middle. Pathum Nissanka looks to reverse-sweep it but misses and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Slightly on the shorter side this time on off. Asalanka late-cuts it to short third man for a single.
Another single now! A tossed up delivery on middle. Nissanka comes charging down the track and hits this hard to long on for a single.
A tossed up delivery on middle. Charith Asalanka skips down the track and heaves it towards the deep mid-wicket region for a single.

Ashton Agar (3-0-9-1) comes back in to finish his spell. The on-air commentators are bringing up a stat that Agar has only gone for singles in this whole series. Not even twos or threes, let alone a boundary. If that is true, then it is a staggering stat.
Loopy delivery on off this time. Charith Asalanka works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off. Nissanka skips down the track and pushes it to long on for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Charith Asalanka works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on off. Nissanka goes back and cuts it to deep point for a single.
On off and quicker this time. Charith Asalanka late cuts it to short third man for a single.
Zampa pulls his length back and seves this on off. Charith Asalanka looks to reverse sweep but misses. The ball hits him on his thigh and there is a slight appeal but no damage done.
Adam Zampa (1-0-6-0) comes back in to replace Ashton Agar.
Again Sams bangs this short on middle. This time Charith Asalanka pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Shorter and angling into the body now. Charith Asalanka looks to pull but misses and gets hit on his body.
Back of a length, around off. Charith Asalanka blocks it out towards the off side.
FOUR! Charith Asalanka gets into the act now! A fuller slower delivery outside off. Charith Asalanka gets low and gets under it. He smashes this straight down the ground for a boundary.
Sams bowls this on a length again but on the off stump line now. Asalanka blocks it out.
On a length, on middle. Nissanka works it to fine leg for a single.
Daniel Sams (1-0-8-0) is back into the attack.
Shorter and on off this time. Asalanka blocks it out.
A fuller delivery on off. Nissanka knocks it down to long off for a single.
Charith Asalanka is in at number 4.
A flatter delivery on off. Nissanka drives it to covers.

OUT! RUN OUT! Mendis is on his way and he will be disappointed with that! A fuller delivery on middle. Nissanka works it towards mid-wicket with soft hands and the batters try to steal a second run. However, Maxwell comes charging in and collects it quickly. He fires a driect hit at the bowler's end and Mendis though puts in a dive, is out of his crease. The replays confirm it and Sri Lanka lose their second.

That seems to be a Run-Out! The umpire nods his head but takes it upstairs just to be sure. The batters try to push for two but take on the wrong fielder. Glenn Maxwell runs in from deep mid-wicket, has a bullet of a throw and the stumps at the bowler's end are shattered. The replay shows that Kusal Mendis is nowhere in the frame. OUT!
Quicker around leg again. Mendis works it towards the leg side for a single.
Darted on middle and leg. Nissanka works it to square leg for a single.

SIX! Kusal Mendis with another big hit. Short of a length, on off. Mendis seems to be waiting for it and he clears the front leg and has a swat at it. The ball comes off the higher part of the bat but carries all the way over the long on fence.
Drop and run! Back of a length, on off. Nissanka hops and bunts it on the off side for a sneaky single.
Shorter and slower, outside off. Mendis fetches it and pulls it down towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length this time, angled into middle. Mendis keeps it out.
Banged in short, over off. Mendis pulls it straight down to mid-wicket.

Extra run! A length ball, outside off. Mendis leans in and drives it towards extra cover for a quick single. The fielder over there has a shy at the bowler's end but there's no one backing up and the batters get an extra run.
A sixth single to finish the over! This is quicker and is bowled fuller, on middle and leg. Mendis pushes it through mid on for one more.
Just knocking it into the gaps at the moment. On middle, Nissanka works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller in length, this is driven through mid on for one.
Out comes the leggie. On a length and outside off. Nissanka cuts it through cover-point for a run.
Around middle and leg, tucked away 'round the corner for one more.
Some turn on offer from Zampa right from the off. Flatter, around off and spinning into the right-hander. Nissanka watchfully turns it on the leg side for a single.
Adam Zampa is into the attack now. He replaces Ashton Agar.

SIX! Kusal Mendis takes Maxwell on and sends the ball into orbit. Tossed up, around middle. Mendis gets low and smokes it over the wide long on fence for a biggie. Really positive start this from Sri Lanka.
Around leg stump, flicked away off the back foot for a single.
Excellent running! Shorter, around leg. Nissanka turns it through mid-wicket and sets his eyes on a couple straightaway. He gets it in the end with ease.
These two are just keeping the scoreboard ticking over at the moment. On the pads, tucked 'round the corner for one more.
Shorter and angled well across off. Nissanka looks to punch it off the back foot but mistimes it towards cover. Single taken.
Angled across the off pole. Mendis hangs deep and cuts it late towards short third man for a quick single.
Glenn Maxwell is back on. He went for 9 runs in his first over.
Another single to end the over. Shorter again, on off. Mendis makes room and works it through covers for one.
Short and wide, this is slapped away to deep point for a single.
Here comes the change, 103 clicks and darted into middle. Nissanka does well to keep it out.
Risky single! Around off and turning away a bit. This is driven towards cover-point for a quick single.
A bit of flight there, outside off and on a length. Mendis looks to drive but ends up getting an outside edge.
Shorter and outside off. Nissanka backs away and strokes it to deep cover for a single.
A dot to end the Powerplay and Sri Lanka are 41/1! This is angled into middle and leg. Mendis nudges it on the leg side.
FOUR! Beautifully timed! Length again, just a bit of width on offer. Kusal Mendis lets the ball come onto the bat and caresses it through the point region for a boundary.
A length ball, on off. Mendis wirts it away and the ball falls just short of mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery, over 140 clicks again and on off. Mendis is pushed on the back foot and is able to defend it out.
Right on the money at 144.3 kph. Mendis pushes it out towards the cover region.
Back of a length, around 141 clicks and skimming off the surface. Nissanka dabs it down on the off side for a single.
Jhye Richardson (1-0-4-0) is back on.
Very full on off this time. Mendis blocks it out this time,

Ohh...in the air but just over Agar there! A slower delivery on middle. Nissanka is early on his clip shot there and the ball finds the leading edge of his blade. It goes in the air but just over the bowler's head for a single. Agar jumps to catch it but fails to get a finger on it.
Fuller and just outside off. Nissanka pushes it toward the off side.
Kusal Mendis walks in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! This is poor batting, there was no need for this big shot but he goes for it and perishes! A fuller delivery on middle. Danushka Gunathilaka goes for a big slog-sweep but gets an outside edge this time. The ball loops up in the air towards the point region and Aaron Finch running behind takes a good catch. Agar provides the first breakthrough.
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Ashton Agar

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and following Danushka Gunathilaka this time. On middle and leg. Danushka Gunathilaka punches it back to the bowler.
A fuller delivery on off. Danushka Gunathilaka makes room and slams it hard back to the bowler.
Spin from both ends now. Ashton Agar is getting ready to bowl.
Shorter on off this time. Danushka Gunathilaka punches it to long off for a single. Good start this for Sri Lanka.
Flatter on middle now. Nissanka works it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nissanka on the charge now! A tossed up delivery on off. Nissanka gets low and gets under it to tonk it over mid on for a boundary.
Short and a bit of width on offer this time. Danushka Gunathilaka cuts it through point for three runs. Good running.
On middle and slower in the air. Danushka Gunathilaka looks to sweep but gets hit on his shoulders.
Quicker and flatter delivery around leg. Danushka Gunathilaka looks to work it towards the leg side but gets a leading edge towards the off side.
Glenn Maxwell is into the attack now.
Change of pace this time! Shorter on middle. Danushka Gunathilaka is early on pull but manages to pull it uppishly towards backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Nissanka pushes it towards backward point for another single.
Back  of a length, on off. Danushka Gunathilaka drops it onto the turf and takes a single.
SIX! BANG! Shorter length delivery on off. Danushka Gunathilaka dances down the track, makes room and slaps it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
On a length, around off. Nissanka dabs it to backward point for a single.

FOUR! Nissanka gets his second boundary now and a bit lucky this time. A good-length delivery around off. Nissanka goes pushing for it but gets a thick outside edge. The ball races away through the vacant slip corridor for a boundary.
A change in the attack straightaway. Kane Richardson comes on to bowl now.
A single to end the over! On a length, on midlde and leg. Nissanka works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
On a length, on off over 140 clicks. Nissanka blocks this off the front foot.
On a length, on off. Danushka Gunathilaka pushes it to mid off and takes a quick single. Good running.
Goes fuller this time on middle. Danushka Gunathilaka plays it back to the bowler.
Play and a miss this time! On a length and going across the left-hander this time. Danushka Gunathilaka throws his bat at that one but misses.
On a length, on middle. Danushka Gunathilaka flicks it to deep square leg for a couple.
Jhye Richardson to share the new ball with Daniel Sams.
FOUR! First boundary for Nissanka and Sri Lanka! On a length and this time drifting on the pads. Nissanka clips it towards fine leg for a boundary. Good start for Sri Lanka.
On a length, on off. Danushka Gunathilaka pushes it to mid on and takes a quick single.
Sams bangs this short again on middle. Nissanka pulls it to square leg for a single.
Another delivery that is slightly shorter in length on middle. Danushka Gunathilaka gets the inside edge onto his pads as he looks to punch this. A single taken towards the leg side.
Back of a length, outside off. Danushka Gunathilaka blocks it out towards the off side.
Sams starts with back-of-a-length delivery around off. Nissanka dabs it to backward point and gets off the mark. Sri Lanka are underway.

We are all set to begin! Australian players are out there in the middle. Pathum Nissanka and Danushka Gunathilaka are the openers for Sri Lanka. Can they set the tone tonight? Daniel Sams will start with the ball for Australia. Here we go...

Australia (Playing XI) - Ashton Agar, Ben McDermott, Aaron Finch(C), Josh Inglis, Glenn Maxwell, Marcus Stoinis, Matthew Wade(WK), Daniel Sams, Jhye Richardson (In for Josh Hazlewood), Kane Richardson and Adam Zampa (In for Mitchell Starc).

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Danushka Gunathilaka, Pathum Nissanka, Charith Asalanka, Kusal Mendis, Dinesh Chandimal(WK), Dasun Shanaka(C), Chamika Karunaratne, Jeffrey Vandersay, Dushmantha Chameera, Maheesh Theekshana and Lahiru Kumara (In for Nuwan Thushara).
TOSS - Up goes the flip of the coin and it lands in favour of Australia. They have elected to BOWL first.

Sri Lanka have played some good cricket in patches but have been unable to put consistent pressure on the Aussies to produce positive results. Pathum Nissanka has shown his class at the top of the order but apart from him, the batting unit has struggled. The bowling unit has done decently but with Wanindu Hasaranga not available it will be a tough task for them to overpower Australia on their home turf. However, they do have quality in their ranks and if their batter can step up, we might see a different result today. Can they register their first win of the series? Or will mighty Aussies continue to dominate? We shall find out. Toss and team sheets in a while.

Australia were always expected to win this series on their home turf and the Kangaroos have lived up to the expectations quite well. Though they would have loved some more runs from their batting unit, the bowlers have down their job quite well. On the batting front, Ben McDermott and Josh Inglis have scored some runs but they would want to get some more runs under their belt before some of the senior players return back to the fold. We might see some experimentation from the Aussies in this game and it will be interesting to see how they go about their business with series already sealed.

Hello and a warm welcome to the fourth T20I of this five-match T20I series between Australia and Sri Lanka. The series is already sealed by the Aussies with an unassailable lead of 3-0 but given the T20 World Cup later this year Down Under, it is another opportunity for both these teams to fine-tune their preparation.
... MATCH DAY …
